caveat: The stager sets RUSTFLAGS="-Zthreads=1 -C link-arg=-Wl,--threads=1" and cannot be edited; the controller appends -C overflow-checks=yes to it instead of replacing it (historical run-extraction.sh used RUSTFLAGS="-C overflow-checks=yes" alone). Same flag, extra thread-limit flags.
conclusion: overflow-checks ON reproduces the gate checked form of M31.neg (on_matches_gate true, off false); all later extractions use it.
